title: GURPS Martial Arts
label: GURPS Martial Arts
notes: GCA cites this book as MA65, and a record the Basic Set also prints as MA65, B230; those are left to the system's packs, and the few the book adds under a Basic Set citation (Fast-Draw and Thrown Weapon specialties, Hidden Lore (Hidden Styles), Arm Lock (Tonfa), two Codes of Honor, three weapons) are kept by hand in martial-arts-by-hand.json. PDF page = book page + 1. The Extra Attack modifiers are p. 44 of [MODIFIERS]; Single Skill is a placeholder there and kept by hand. The parsers do not read the file's templates, so styles and character templates are kept by hand. Techniques for an open skill and techniques off an attribute are not written by the parser (sargas79/GWorldVTT#194, #195); the 66 named techniques off a Parry, Block or Dodge, and an open Dual-Weapon Defense for melee weapon skills, are kept by hand until the parser's open techniques and attribute defaults are right (sargas79/GWorldVTT#368); attack modes with the unarmed damage bonus are left off their weapons (#196); weapons with a mode used at a penalty to hit are excluded (#199). See TRIAGE.md.
